answers.goal: My ultimate goal would be to be a screenwriter/director and use my skills to amplify minority voices through my storytelling.
answers.drew: I was drawn to the entertainment industry through screenwriters like Paddy Chayefsky and authors like Milan Kundera. Both writers who are able to understand the internal dynamics within the human and translate it beautifully onto paper.
answers.seeking: Anyone who is interested in acting, creating a writing circle or working with people who are interested in collaborating.
answers.inspiration: My biggest inspiration would be Remedios Varo. The imagery she is able to capture through her surrealist touch is something I aspire to create. She has a vision unlike any other artist I have seen and has the ability to create these anthropomorphic creatures who leave you breathless. I take the inspiration she gives me and try to translate it into my screenwriting by creating surreal worlds.
